scope.description: Whole graphviz application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Graph description, directed/undirected layout engines, constraints, clusters/ranks, node/edge styling and output formats.

coverage.rationale: Automatic directed graph publication covers a core family, but other engines, clusters, rich constraints and presentation features remain excluded.

scope.description: Named directed dependency/feedback graphs with automatic TB/LR layout and editable DOT/SVG.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Named dependencies and direction hide DOT generation and native execution; richer task semantics and layout objectives remain manual.

limitations: Two to 200 nodes; unique nonself edges; no clusters, authored DOT, URLs, HTML labels or images.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
